title: Creamy Thai Chicken Soup
description: A rich and flavorful Thai-inspired soup made with velvety coconut milk and tender chicken.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Add the curry paste and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the chicken and cook until browned, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the broth, fish sauce, soy sauce, and brown sugar. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10-15 minutes.
Stir in the coconut milk and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Garnish with fresh basil leaves and serve hot.
